name: Classic Caprese Salad
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
method: Alternate slices of tomato and mozzarella on a plate. Intersperse with fresh basil leaves. Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze, then season with salt and pepper.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
Salt and red pepper flakes to taste
method: Melt butter in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add shrimp, salt, and pepper flakes; sauté for 3-4 minutes until pink. Stir in lemon juice and parsley before serving.

name: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
ingredients: Salt, black pepper, and chili flakes
method: Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper; spread over toast. Bring a pot of water to a simmer with vinegar, swirl the water, and gently drop in eggs to poach for 3 minutes. Top toast with eggs and sprinkle with chili flakes.

name: Quick Chicken Quesadilla
ingredients: Salsa and sour cream for serving
method: Melt half the butter in a skillet over medium heat. Place one tortilla in the pan, layer with cheese and shredded chicken, and top with the second tortilla. Cook for 3 minutes per side until golden brown and cheese is melted. Slice and serve with salsa.

name: Berry Banana Smoothie
method: Add banana, berries, Greek yogurt, almond milk, and honey into a high-speed blender. Blend on high for 60 seconds until smooth and creamy. Pour into a glass and serve immediately.
